Joins all tracts to pre-aggregated 2025 311 and code-violation counts and CDC population, computes per-1,000-resident rates, keeps the non-null paired tract set, and returns the Pearson correlation with paired tract count ranked by 311 request rate.
sql:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT geoid,
         SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'm1_city' AND grp = 'all' THEN n END) AS request_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'm2_city' AND grp = 'all' THEN n END) AS violation_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261026_9a20fe' AND source IN ('m1_city','m2_city') AND grp = 'all'
  GROUP BY geoid
),
pop AS (
  SELECT CAST(tractfips AS STRING) AS geoid,
         CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation
  FROM session.fw_9a20fe_population_cdc
),
base AS (
  SELECT t.name,
         t.geoid,
         COALESCE(c.request_count, 0) AS request_count,
         COALESCE(c.violation_count, 0) AS violation_count,
         p.totalpopulation
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN counts c ON c.geoid = t.geoid
  LEFT JOIN pop p ON p.geoid = t.geoid
  WHERE t.geoid IS NOT NULL
),
paired AS (
  SELECT name,
         geoid,
         request_count,
         violation_count,
         totalpopulation,
         CAST(request_count AS DOUBLE) / totalpopulation * 1000.0 AS request_rate_per_1000,
         CAST(violation_count AS DOUBLE) / totalpopulation * 1000.0 AS violation_rate_per_1000
  FROM base
  WHERE totalpopulation IS NOT NULL AND totalpopulation > 0
)
SELECT name,
       request_rate_per_1000,
       violation_rate_per_1000,
       request_count,
       violation_count,
       totalpopulation,
       CORR(request_rate_per_1000, violation_rate_per_1000) OVER () AS correlation,
       COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
       geoid
FROM paired
WHERE request_rate_per_1000 IS NOT NULL AND violation_rate_per_1000 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY request_rate_per_1000 DESC NULLS LAST, name ASC
LIMIT 200
